title: Department of Labor (DOL Open Data API: OSHA, WHD, ETA unemployment claims, MSHA; OUI unemployment insurance trust fund files)
questions: OSHA inspections and penalties for a company
serious OSHA violations in a state
back wages recovered by the Wage and Hour Division in an industry
a state's unemployment trust fund balance, latest month
which states have outstanding Title XII loans for unemployment benefits
state UI tax contributions and benefits paid by month
unemployment trust fund solvency (average high cost multiple) by state

key_only: every data query (only the dataset catalog and field dictionaries are keyless)

manual.how: Open each link in manual_download/INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser after replacing {API_KEY} with your own DOL API key (free: register at https://dataportal.dol.gov/registration, then copy a key from https://dataportal.dol.gov/api-keys), or run download_data.sh / download_data.ps1 (one command; asks for the key with hidden input); save each JSON file under the name shown, upload them, then --ingest. Without the bundle: open the dataset in the Data Catalog (https://dataportal.dol.gov/datasets), use the API Query Builder at the bottom of the page (signed in) to set filters and download the response, or use the agency's own downloads (OSHA: https://www.osha.gov/data; WHD: https://enforcedata.dol.gov; weekly claims: https://oui.doleta.gov/unemploy/claims.asp); upload the file and say which it is. The unemployment insurance trust fund files need no key: download https://oui.doleta.gov/unemploy/csv/ar2112.csv (ETA 2112, listed on https://oui.doleta.gov/unemploy/DataDownloads.asp) or https://oui.doleta.gov/unemploy/data_summary/SummaryTables.xlsx (https://oui.doleta.gov/unemploy/data_summary/DataSum.asp) and upload it unchanged.

cache.why: Enforcement datasets are reloaded daily to quarterly, claims weekly, the ETA 2112 file monthly; data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: DOL data are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105). Enforcement records name employers (public records); the DOL API terms forbid sharing API keys, not data.

citation: U.S. Department of Labor, {dataset}, DOL Open Data API (apiprod.dol.gov/v4) or Office of Unemployment Insurance data (oui.doleta.gov), retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Seasonally adjusted or not seasonally adjusted claims? The weekly national table has both (c5/c7 adjusted, c4/c6 not); state tables are not seasonally adjusted.
Enforcement counts measure enforcement activity, not violations in the economy: report them as inspections or cases found, by the date field used (open date, issuance date, findings end date).

Trust fund balance from the state's monthly ETA 2112 report (ui_trust_fund, dollars) or the quarterly Data Summary (ui_data_summary, Treasury account balances in thousands, with Title XII loan balances and solvency measures)? Default: the 2112 for monthly detail, the Data Summary for loans and solvency.
